heading: Updates and improvements to Battlefield Reports
lead: Not later than 2 years after the date of the enactment of this section, and every 10 years thereafter, the Secretary shall submit to Congress a report that updates the Battlefield Reports to reflect—

tree.text: preservation activities carried out at the battlefields in the period since the publication of the most recent Battlefield Reports update;
changes in the condition, including core and study areas, of the battlefields during that period; and
any other relevant developments relating to the battlefields during that period.

notes.text: References in TextThe date of the enactment of this section, referred to in introductory provisions, is the date of enactment of Pub. L. 118–234, which was approved Jan. 4, 2025.
